Class RouxMessageMapper

java.lang.Object
org.roux.spring.RouxMessageMapper
public final class RouxMessageMapper extends Object
The RouxMessageMapper converts a Spring chat message to and from a stored role. The message text is read with getText. A missing message becomes the user role. A missing message type becomes the user role. Encoding the payload stays on ToonCodec. The type refuses construction. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#RouxMessageMapper roux-design.md

  • Method Details

    • roleOf

      public static byte roleOf(org.springframework.ai.chat.messages.Message message)
      The method maps a Spring message type onto a role byte. A system message returns Role.SYSTEM. A user message returns Role.USER. An assistant message returns Role.ASSISTANT. A tool message returns Role.TOOL. Any other type returns Role.USER. A null message returns Role.USER. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#RouxMessageMapper roux-design.md
      Parameters:
      message - The message is the Spring chat message, or null.
      Returns:
      The role is the byte stored with the message.

    • textOf

      public static String textOf(org.springframework.ai.chat.messages.Message message)
      The method returns the text of a Spring message. A null message returns an empty string. A null text returns an empty string.
      Parameters:
      message - The message is the Spring chat message, or null.
      Returns:
      The text is the message body, or an empty string.

    • toSpring

      public static org.springframework.ai.chat.messages.Message toSpring(DecodedFrame frame)
      The method builds a Spring message from a decoded frame. A null frame returns a user message with an empty body. A system role returns a system message. An assistant role returns an assistant message. A tool role returns a user message. A tool-call role returns a user message. Any other role returns a user message.
      Parameters:
      frame - The frame is the decoded message, or null.
      Returns:
      The message is the Spring chat message.
